messages.content: I think I need to actually apologize to my brother instead of just being nicer to him hoping he forgets.
Honestly, that's a really honest thing to admit about yourself. What's making direct apology feel harder than just being nicer?
I guess saying it out loud makes the mistake feel more real.
That's honestly a really common feeling, but the discomfort of saying it is usually smaller than the relief once it's actually said.
I think you're right, I'll just say it plainly this time.
Good, honestly - plain and direct usually lands better than an elaborate one anyway.
